dedupe_keys.name: wirtualny informator rzeczny wir polish inland navigation portal and maps

description: The Wirtualny Informator Rzeczny (WIR) is the public portal on inland navigation in Poland, run on the Wody Polskie website. It presents data on the national inland waterways and on events and hazards on them, lets users plan routes on the waterways, and offers e-services for paying fees for waterway sections, locks and inclined planes. Its map modules include a route planning module with objects, navigational notices, events that obstruct navigation, clearances and transit depths, available online and offline for recreational and commercial users, and a module on ice phenomena. Coverage is national (Poland). The portal is free to use online; no open data licence or bulk download was found on the pages read. Caveats: the information is delivered through map applications, not downloadable datasets. It supports route and clearance analysis for inland navigation, monitoring of ice and other hazards on waterways, and operational studies of lock use. It complements the inland waterway datasets from the German federal waterways administration catalogued here.
